description: This file defines the LanguageHelper class, which provides methods for managing language strings, language packs, and translations within the OrangeHRM system, including reading language strings from YAML files, database operations for language data, and creating/deleting test language packs.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing language strings, language packs, and translations in the OrangeHRM system, including database interactions and YAML parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and associates them with a specific group.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a language group by its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings from the database based on unit ID and optional group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a translation for a specific language string into the database.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches the language ID associated with a language code.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Updates the enabled and added status of a language identified by its code.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack with dummy translations for testing purposes.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Removes the test language pack and its translations from the database.
